title: Debug: Synchronized Edge Detector
constraints: Intended behavior: `din` is asynchronous. It passes through a **2-flop synchronizer** (s1 ← din, s2 ← s1), then a third flop s3 ← s2 delays it once more.
`level = s2`, `rise = s2 & ~s3`, `fall = ~s2 & s3`. All are combinational from the flops, so a change on `din` shows up on `level`/`rise` two edges later.
Nothing may use `s1` except `s2`: it may be metastable. Synchronous reset clears all flops. The starter has **2 bugs**.
hints: Count the edges between a `din` change and the `rise` pulse. The spec says 2.
Toggle `din` slowly: 0 → 1 → 0. How many pulses appear on `fall`, and when?
Reading the first synchronizer stage anywhere else is a real metastability bug, even if it looks faster in simulation.

examples.title: rise
examples.expected: level = 1 and a one-cycle rise pulse, two edges later

examples.title: fall
examples.expected: one-cycle fall pulse, two edges later
